releaseName: Multi-Platform Compatibility (Tablet, iOS, Windows) & Crystal Clear Light Mode Redesign

highlights: Crystal Clear High-Contrast Light Mode: Complete UI redesign for light theme with calibrated typography, snowy cards, high-contrast borders, refined categorical pastels, and zero dark artifacts
Automatic Screen Size & Device Adaptation: Real-time detection across Mobile, Tablet, Desktop, and Ultrawide displays with dynamic CSS custom properties (--app-width, --app-height, --vh)
Tablet Split-View Enhancements: Optimized dual-pane layouts for iPads & Android tablets across Reading Passages, Writing Studio, and 2x2 Category Progress Grid
iOS Safe Area & WebKit Compatibility: Viewport-fit=cover, environment insets (notch/home indicator safe padding), momentum touch scrolling, and speech synthesis user gesture unlock
Windows Fluent Desktop Integration: Custom slim acrylic scrollbars, high-DPI scaling, and keyboard shortcuts (Alt+1..5 navigation, Alt+T theme toggle, Escape modal dismiss)
System Color Scheme Sync: Automatically aligns with OS light/dark mode preference with persistent manual override in local storage
